segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, yeah, this is Megan from Northstar Dental Group. We need to add 6 seats to our account before Monday, and I wanted to make sure the pricing lines up with our current annual plan.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can I confirm the account is Northstar Dental Group on the annual Growth plan, renewal date November 30, 2026?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. We currently have 42 users, and we need to move to 48. Same access level as the rest of the operations team.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’m checking the billing tool now. The prorated charge for 6 additional seats through November 30 comes to $1,284.00 before tax. The ongoing renewal would reflect 48 seats at your current contracted rate.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I expected. Can you add them today and send the receipt to ap@northstardental.com?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. I’ve added the 6 seats in the admin console, and the billing tool is generating the charge now. You should see invoice 41872 sent to ap@northstardental.com in the next few minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do I need to do anything to assign those seats, or will they show up for our admin?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: They’ll show up right away for your admin users. If you go to Admin, then Users, you should see 6 available seats. You can invite the new users from there.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, I see the available seats now. Thanks for turning that around.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. I’ll note ticket 236119 as completed, and the invoice copy is on its way.
